title: 4 Vnto whom the miniſterie is to be committed.

segments.text: VNTO whom the miniſtery of the Church ought to be committed, Saint Paul plainly deliuereth in his Epiſtles to Timothy, and to Titus. And, briefly to compriſe them; The miniſterie of the Church is to bee committed, 1. Vnto men, 2. hauing a good teſtimonie in and without the church, 3. able to teach, that is, Rightly vnderſtanding the doctrine, and hauing giftes in ſome meaſure rightly to propound the ſame.
